name: Kawauchi Ai
source:
A maiden working as a member of the library committee.
She's basically a calm, quiet and shy kind of character, but she also can be really talkative when she's discussing about books she's fond of. She was in the same elementary school as the MC, as they were basically senpai and kouhai, also they were both in the library committee. Her heart was more open at that time.
